title: My Ontologist: Evaluating BFO-Based AI for Definition Support
reasoning: The paper evaluates the performance of LLMs (such as GPT-4 and GPT-5) in generating ontology content aligned with the Basic Formal Ontology (BFO) framework. While it discusses philosophical commitments like 'ontological realism' and 'perspectivalism,' these are addressed in the context of information science and engineering for defense applications, rather than evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
